entities.summary: Sunday Jack Akpan is a Nigerian sculptor who has been described as "the contemporary African equivalent of the medieval artisan". He is noted for his work in cement, in which he crafts traditional-style statues of tribal leaders and other figures, mainly as grave art, which he then paints. He has also created other types of commercial art, including religious figures and business signage. His work has been shown at the Venice Biennale and at the Centre Pompidou in Paris, among other venues.
